Title: 498992-2026: France – Services of architectural, construction and engineering offices and testing laboratories – Notice of result of design competition for the construction of a tennis and multisport hall at the Omblais sports complex
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a multi-purpose sports hall (~2,892 m² with four tennis courts) — sports buildings and long-span hall roofs are generally very interesting for sbp. The project is located in France and the budget is moderate, but it remains structurally relevant.
titel: Competition for the design of a tennis and multisport hall in the Omblais sports complex
kurzbeschreibung: A tennis and multisport hall with four tennis courts is planned in Betton.
umfang: New construction of a tennis and multisport hall in the Omblais sports complex with an estimated area of 2,892 m2; four tennis courts are planned, two of which are multi-purpose, as well as a lounge or meeting area; photovoltaics are planned but are not part of the construction scope budgeted here.
leistungen: Competition for planning services for object and specialist planning as maîtrise d'oeuvre; Esquisse+; subsequent negotiated contract without further notice for a basic service and additional services.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Sports building with a potentially long-span hall structure and therefore generally a good fit for sbp.
• Early competition phase is strategically relevant, as sbp often collaborates with architectural offices in competitions.
• New hall construction with potential need for an efficient structural concept, roof structure and sustainability approaches.
• Project size is solid, but with 2,892 m2 and construction costs of EUR 3.0 million it is rather medium-sized.
• No explicit focus mentioned on exceptional spans, special structures or innovative materials.
• Location in France is in principle manageable for sbp, but it is not on the watchlist and without particular market signals.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the tender; the expected financial envelope allocated to the construction works of EUR 3,000,000 net, excluding the photovoltaic system, is stated.
honorar_erklaerung: No explicit fee stated. It is only known that after the competition a contract for the maîtrise d'oeuvre with basic and additional services is to be awarded. For a reliable fee estimate, information is lacking on the scope of services, share of structural design, fee split within the team and chargeable costs by specialist lots.
referenzen_qualifikationen: The names and professional qualifications of the personnel deployed for the performance of the contract must be indicated. In the second phase, 3 candidates will be selected. The evaluation criteria are the qualifications of the bidder team as well as technical, professional and financial capacity, the quality of project-appropriate references and environmental aspects.
zuschlagskriterien: No percentage weighting stated; the evaluation covers economic and financial requirements, qualifications of the bidder team including technical, professional and financial capacities, quality of references suitable for the project, and environmental considerations.
auftraggeber: COMMUNE DE BETTON, Place du Général de Gaulle, 35830 Betton, France; Contact: Service de la commande publique; E-mail: marches.publics@betton.fr; Telephone: 0299558101; Website: https://www.betton.fr/accueil
notes: This is the contract award notice for an architectural and engineering competition. The selected prizewinner is KRAFT Architectes, 22 rue de la Monnaie, 35000 Rennes. Start of execution is stated as 01.10.2026, with a duration of 20 months. Photovoltaics are expressly not part of the construction cost framework indicated here, as the installation will be carried out by an external operator.
